NeoNilam BALANCE

Less time building the base.
More time building the product.

NeoNilam BALANCE develops the same platform toward a more defined nutrient starting profile.

Discuss Target Profile ↗

It is intended for customers who want to begin closer to their target rather than build the entire nutrient system from the BASE matrix.

Benefits

More defined starting chemistry

Begin from an agreed nutrient direction rather than a fully open base.

Less downstream adjustment

Reduce part of the work required to build the final nutrient profile.

Application-led

Profiles can be developed around crop, market or formulation needs.

Still configurable

BALANCE is not a single fixed recipe. It is a more advanced starting point for B2B product development.

the nutrient profile to land.
